fassungen.wortlaut: It should be possible to assign a task to an agent without a matching qualification too; this is not refused but is a conflict and shows as one. The hint while dragging then says “Works, but without matching qualification: conflict”.
fassungen.wortlautDeutsch: Ein Auftrag soll auch einem Mitarbeiter ohne passende Qualifikation zugewiesen werden können; das wird nicht verweigert, sondern ist ein Konflikt und erscheint als solcher. Der Hinweis beim Ziehen sagt dann „Geht, aber ohne passende Qualifikation: Konflikt“.
fassungen.kurz: A task can now also be assigned to an agent without a matching qualification. It stays there and shows as the conflict “Missing qualification”. While dragging, the pointer shows “Works, but without matching qualification: conflict”.

erwartungen.satz: XC 810 Fuelling to I. Reindl is now a conflict instead of refused.

alt.text: XC 810 Fuelling stays with D. Mahler, because I. Reindl is not allowed to fuel.

neu.text: XC 810 Fuelling is now with I. Reindl, although she is not allowed to fuel; that is a “Missing qualification” conflict.

erwartungen.satz: XC 810 Cabin cleaning to D. Mahler is now a conflict instead of refused.

alt.text: XC 810 Cabin cleaning stays with I. Reindl, because D. Mahler is not allowed to do cleaning.

neu.text: XC 810 Cabin cleaning is now with D. Mahler, although he is not allowed to do cleaning; that is a “Missing qualification” conflict.

erwartungen.satz: At the end there are 7 conflicts instead of 5, because the two assignments without qualification now count as conflicts.

alt.text: The conflict counter is at 5, because XA 745 Fuelling and Lavatory service no longer overlap for F. Ohlsen.

neu.text: The conflict counter is at 7: XA 745 Fuelling and Lavatory service no longer overlap for F. Ohlsen, but the qualification is missing for XC 810 Fuelling and XC 810 Cabin cleaning.

erwartungen.satz: XC 810 Loading to D. Mahler is now assigned (temporarily a conflict) instead of refused.

alt.text: D. Mahler does not get XC 810 Loading, because he is not qualified for loading.

neu.text: D. Mahler gets XC 810 Loading at first, although he is not qualified for loading; then the dispatcher drags it on to W. Fiedler.

fassungen.wortlaut: On drag over / hover, when an assignment is about to be moved to a colleague without the qualification, please show this in red in the tooltip
fassungen.wortlautDeutsch: Bitte beim Drag over / Hover wenn ein Einsatz verschoben werden soll auf einen Kollegen, der die Qualifikation nicht hat, das im Tooltip rot mit anzeigen
fassungen.kurz: If you drag an assignment onto a colleague without the right qualification, a red note appears at the pointer, for example “I. Reindl has no qualification for Fuelling: conflict”, and his row is outlined in red. The assignment is still allowed.
Switched to the bus contract: only this plugin now changes a task's agent, start and end. It now also handles “unassigned” (after a sick call) and “back to the list”; the behaviour stays the same.

entscheidungen.was: If you drag a bar in the daily plan onto an agent (e.g. XA 101 Unloading onto D. Mahler), both “Drag bars to other agents” and “Change assignment” want to take it over.
entscheidungen.wie: by the PO with a click on “Drag bars to other agents takes over”
